name: SP Lead Insights for Contact Form 7
author: salmanpatnee

sections.description:
SP Lead Insights for Contact Form 7 gives you a built-in analytics dashboard for Contact Form 7 — no Google Analytics required. Track form views, submission rates, and blocked spam attempts, all from WP admin.

Free features:
* Form view and submission tracking
* Conversion rate per form (views ÷ submissions)
* Email domain blocklist with validation errors
* Honeypot spam protection
* Block log with timestamps and reasons
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sp-lead-insights-for-contact-form-7 folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin in the WordPress admin under Plugins.
  3. Contact Form 7 must also be active.

No configuration required — tracking begins immediately on activation.
sections.faq:
Does this store email addresses or form field values?

No. SP Lead Insights for Contact Form 7 stores only event metadata: form ID, event type, status, and a hashed (non-reversible) IP address. No submission content is ever stored.

Is this GDPR-compliant?

Yes. IP addresses are stored as one-way HMAC-SHA256 hashes using your site’s unique secret key (AUTH_SALT). Raw IP addresses are never stored and the hashes cannot be reversed.

Because SP Lead Insights stores only hashed IPs (never email addresses), the WordPress privacy erasure tool cannot locate records by email address. If you receive a Subject Access Request or erasure request, the relevant data is the hashed IP — which is already pseudonymised and cannot be linked back to an individual without the original IP address.
